resources.string: This app lets the Nook Wi-Fi plugin in KOReader turn Wi-Fi on and off and join networks. You do not need to open it again after setup.\n\nAndroid only shows Wi-Fi network names to apps with location access. The helper never uses your location.
Location access is needed for scanning and network names.
All set. You can close this app and use Nook Wi-Fi in KOReader under Settings → Network.
Android will not ask again. Open the app settings, tap Permissions, and turn on Location.
